causal_variable: developmental exposure horizon to the identifying predicate field
evidence_ceiling: This screen can establish, weaken, or reveal non-monotonic developmental-horizon effects for the opaque predicate under the fixed CapybaraHermes/Mistral learner. It cannot establish a universal CFE dose law or developmental ecology law.
hard_prohibitions: No post-outcome horizon extension beyond H4.
No post-outcome row-order, optimizer, profile, support, prompt, or evaluator changes.
No separate initialization per horizon within a seed.
No StarMap-derived learner-facing geometry intervention in parallel.
StarMap S0/S1 curator-side instrumentation may proceed only if it does not change candidate bytes, training order, evaluation, or runtime.
per_seed_schedule: one deterministic permutation of all 72 predicate rows, frozen before outcomes and repeated identically each epoch; same trajectory yields H1/H2/H4 checkpoints

trigger_all: neither H2 nor H4 yields two-sided competence on at least 4 of 6 seeds

DOSE_ROTATES_BASIN_WITHOUT_COMPETENCE.trigger: H2 or H4 causes a material truth-side redistribution while neither HORIZON_IMPROVES_COMPETENCE nor INTERMEDIATE_HORIZON_OPTIMUM is true; treat large slice movement as phenotype rotation, not competence.

requires_all: H4 beats H1 on at least 4 of 6 seeds
pooled H4 false-truth accuracy >= pooled H1 false-truth accuracy
pooled H4 true-truth accuracy >= pooled H1 true-truth accuracy
at least 4 of 6 H4 seeds have false-truth accuracy >= 0.65
at least 4 of 6 H4 seeds have true-truth accuracy >= 0.65
at least 4 of 6 H4 seeds have overall accuracy >= 0.75
H2 beats H1 on at least 4 of 6 seeds
at least 4 of 6 H2 seeds have false-truth accuracy >= 0.65
at least 4 of 6 H2 seeds have true-truth accuracy >= 0.65
at least 4 of 6 H2 seeds have overall accuracy >= 0.75

preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_IF_DOSE_HORIZON_WEAKENED: prioritize richer predicate-field resolution and learner-interface/decomposition discrimination; do not extend beyond H4 adaptively
preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_IF_HORIZON_IMPROVES_COMPETENCE: replicate the horizon law on a fresh relation/domain before broad promotion
preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_IF_INTERMEDIATE_OPTIMUM: replicate the non-monotonic horizon optimum and investigate overexposure/attractor collapse

question: Holding the exact identifying-predicate experience multiset, learner, optimizer, adapter profile, and per-seed row order fixed, does continued exposure along the same training trajectory move the learner from low-complexity one-sided predicate basins into stable two-sided predicate competence?

trajectory_design.reason: Same-trajectory checkpoints isolate continued exposure from separate initialization variance.
trajectory_design.unit: one fresh initialized learner trajectory per seed
